nodes.label: Research Problem
nodes.detail: Customer switching and multi-homing in Indian quick commerce; coverage constraints must be separated from competitive pull.

nodes.label: Research Objectives
nodes.detail: Four objectives: test PPM model; quantify exit reasons; synthesise with UDRHP-I; formulate testable CRM actions.

nodes.label: Push–Pull–Mooring Framework
nodes.detail: Hypotheses H1–H7 pre-specified before empirical testing.

nodes.label: Primary Survey
nodes.detail: Cross-sectional, non-probability online questionnaire across 3 versions.

nodes.label: Respondent Segmentation
nodes.detail: Branching logic separates intention (current), behavior (former), and non-adoption (never).

nodes.label: Data Preparation
sub: Structural missingness handling (complete-case n=46 for H7/HTMT)
nodes.detail: Early-version omitted items treated as structurally missing, not imputed.

nodes.label: Measurement Quality
nodes.detail: Single-item scales (PROMO1, FAM1, INERT1) noted; HTMT diagnostic evaluated on multi-item complete cases.

nodes.label: Current-User Analysis
sub: Exploratory OLS regression with HC3 robust SEs
nodes.detail: Raw associations examined alongside within-person centered sensitivity models.

nodes.label: Robustness Diagnostics
sub: Raw vs. Within-person centered correlation comparison
nodes.detail: Pull associations attenuate substantially post-centering; switching barriers remain inconclusive.

nodes.label: Former-User Analysis
nodes.detail: Retrospective self-reported behavioral exit drivers; 50.0% of voluntary exits cite availability/variety.

nodes.label: Never-User Context
nodes.detail: Non-adoption baseline; 37/60 (61.7%) cite unserved geographic locality. Excluded from switching models.

nodes.label: Secondary & Company Evidence
nodes.detail: Contextual company disclosure; does not establish individual consumer causality.

nodes.label: Literature Evidence
nodes.detail: 17 tracked literature records categorized into Verification Tiers A/B/C/Unverified.

nodes.label: Evidence Triangulation
sub: Academic literature vs Primary survey vs Former users vs UDRHP
nodes.detail: Synthesizes multi-source findings across 6 core switching factors.

nodes.label: CRM Strategy Recommendations
sub: R4: Switching-barrier re-measurement (Not recommended on current evidence)
nodes.detail: Evidence-linked, testable CRM actions; avoids artificial lock-in assumptions.

nodes.label: Final Interpretation & Claims Ledger
nodes.detail: Empirical summary: what the evidence supports, cautious interpretations, and what should NOT be claimed.
